items.q: Roy White, Roy "Snake" White, he used to play with Zack White's band... But his career came to an early end

ctx.x: Roy White, Roy "Snake" White, he used to play with Zack White's band, and he played trumpet. But his career came to an early end, because he was the kind that liked to fight police when he got drunk. And invariably, he'd get hit in his mouth, so he lost his embouchure. But he could still arrange. And he had a son, this is a sort of a drag. His son was out to this place where they send you for the drug cure, drug hospital.
